commands.name: extract

options.name: --exit-on-duplicate-key
options.description: Exit with error code 1 when duplicate translation keys are found (useful for CI pipelines)

options.name: --format
options.description: Export format: i18next (default, Crowdin i18next  JSON), po (GNU Gettext with source refs), json (full-fidelity debug)

options.name: --locale
options.description: Filter to specific locales. Repeatable (-l da -l  es-MX). Omit to include all discovered locales

options.name: --on-duplicate-key
options.description: Strategy for duplicate translation keys (same key,  different source text). 'first' (default) keeps the first-seen source  text. 'skip' omits the key entirely

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path: a file (e.g. out.po) or directory (e.g.  ./translations). Auto-detected via extension. Omit to write to stdout

options.name: --path-style
options.description: Path style for source references. 'relative' (default) emits paths relative to the project root. 'absolute'  preserves full filesystem paths

options.name: --source-only
options.description: Export source-language strings only; skip per-locale  translations

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print per-project scanning progress to stderr

arguments.name: paths
arguments.description: Directories or .csproj files to scan. Repeatable.  Defaults to current directory

commands.description: Scan your projects for translation strings and export to  translation files (i18next JSON, PO, or generic JSON).

commands.name: inspect

options.name: --json
options.description: Output raw JSON to stdout instead of rendered tables.  Auto-enabled when stdout is piped

options.name: --locale
options.description: Filter to specific locales. Repeatable (-l da -l  es-MX). Omit to include all discovered locales

options.name: --path-style
options.description: Path style for source references. 'relative' (default) emits paths relative to the project root. 'absolute'  preserves full filesystem paths

options.name: --show-extracted-calls
options.description: Show every line of code where a translation was found  (default: warnings only)

options.name: --show-resx-locales
options.description: Show full .resx tables for each language (default:  summary only)

options.name: --source-only
options.description: Export source-language strings only; skip per-locale  translations

arguments.name: paths
arguments.description: Directories or .csproj files to scan. Repeatable.  Defaults to current directory
